title: Phytophthora capsici CTAB DNA Extraction for High-Molecular Weight DNA
author: Pablo Vargas-Mejía
materials: Lyse: Incubate 00:30:00 at 55 °C with gentle shaking ( 200 rpm, °C, ) in a thermomixer.

steps.title: Pre-warm CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Preheat CTAB DNA Extraction Buffer to 55 °C until fully dissolved.

steps.title: Homogenize mycelium
steps.instruction: Grind Phytophthora mycelium in a 1.5 mL tube preloaded with 200 µL warm CTAB buffer using a sterile pestle.

substeps.instruction: Once homogeneous, add 500 µL more CTAB buffer (total 700 µL)
Mix gently by inversion or flicking (do not vortex)

steps.title: Perform first chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 500 µL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and mix by inversion for 00:03:00 (do not vortex).

steps.title: Clarify and recover aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at maximum speed (~ 16000 x g) for 00:10:00.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ONLY the upper aqueous phase to a new tube, avoiding the interphase

steps.title: Perform RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (20 mg/mL), mix gently, and incubate for 00:15:00 at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Optionally add 5 µL of Proteinase K (20 mg/mL)

steps.title: Perform second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and mix by slow inversion for 00:03:00 (no vortex).

steps.title: Clarify and transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:10:00 at maximum speed (~ 16000 x g).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a NEW tube, avoiding any interphase

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 (e.g., 50 µL per 500 µL aqueous) and mix by inversion.

substeps.instruction: Add 500-1000 µL of ice-cold 100% ethanol and invert gently until mixed

steps.title: Incubate for precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate at 80 °C for 30-00:45:00 (or at 20 °C for 60 min).

substeps.instruction: Note pellet location by orienting tube hinges outward

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant carefully and wash the pellet with ice-cold 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice-cold 70% ethanol, invert once or twice, and centrifuge for 00:05:00 at maximum speed
Repeat the 70% ethanol wash once more

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Remove all ethanol with a fine tip and air-dry for 10–00:15:00 until ethanol odor is gone (do not overdry).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend DNA in 50 µL TE buffer (37 °C recommended) or nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve at 4 °C for several hours or overnight with occasional gentle tapping
Use NanoDrop primarily for purity ratios (A260/280, A260/230)
